files.notes.md: Authored synthetic holdout: shard violet replica rejoin. Current approved policy. First pause writes: shardctl writes pause --shard violet. Then inspect: shardctl inspect --shard violet --json. Fields lag_ms integer or null, snapshot_verified boolean or null, active_writers integer. Rejoin allowed ONLY lag_ms<=250 AND snapshot_verified=true AND active_writers=0. Unknown required value: keep writes paused, stop and notify duty lead; never treat null as0orfalse. Known condition fails: same stop, no rejoin or automatic retry. Allowed command shardctl replica rejoin --shard violet. After successful command inspect again with same inspect command. Success ONLY lag_ms=0 AND snapshot_verified=true AND active_writers=0. Rejoin command exit success not enough. If success resume writes with shardctl writes resume --shard violet, then record this shard recovered. Otherwise including unknown keep paused, stop notifylead, no repeat rejoin. Pause/inspect/rejoin command failure: stop notifylead, do not assume effect; no extra recovery command given. Resume failure handling and lead channel not supplied. Operator knows shell/JSON, not thisservice. No other shard/global recovery claim.
